findings.summary: Depth-only task draws read the mesh world at the shared stage's mesh-block slot, from the mesh's own world and deformation buffers (no per-task world buffers).
SDL_GPU stages load through load_shader over their PinnedStageSlots or load_pinned_stage instead of hand-read sidecars and restated entry points.
One backend-neutral .slots line walk and bounded index parser for both backends; stale compaction comments corrected.
Duplicate SDL_GPU scene prototypes removed; esm_texture_format inline.
teardown.hpp writes through write_error_line and exception_message.
One absenceKind rule answers null/undefined for equality, text and typeof.
Loop-counter metadata is dropped where a value is stored; integerCounterOf is a plain field read.
One receiver-mutating method table in a leaf module (sort included).
typedArrayTable takes folded numbers instead of re-parsing emitted C++.
Dead class-member helpers deleted; one statementDeclaredNames walker in syntax.ts.
Adaptation text states the bblite-tint, sidecar, DXC-for-DXIL path.
Source units tokenize each piece once; overload lists grow in place.
Eighteen pass-through compiler forwarders removed in favour of their owners.
Pinned names resolve per module; a checker is built only for type questions (scene1 generation 3.25 s to 2.48 s).
Node's compile cache is enabled in the CLI entry points.
Patch manifest order and inheritedFromVcpkg fields dropped; CMake applies patches in manifest order.
Android and iOS scripts read dependency inputs from the manifest (Get-DependencyInputs).
tint-tool uses contentDigest and the patch-identity series.
package-demo parses --backend through parseBackendName.
Dead shader helpers removed (indent, the one-helper sprite-fx module); text intrinsics share the text record model; three interface lookups use interfaceDeclaration.
Velocity history skipped when the mesh block has no velocity tail.
